candidate_details.summary_statement: Machine-learning engineer & data scientist with 3+ years of experience developing complex audio-visual and biomedical data into robust machine learning models on AWS and data driven solutions. Builds deep-learning pipelines (CNN, RNN/LSTM, Transformers) that deliver up to 90 % accuracy on fusion models. Owns the full lifecycle—from data wrangling to MLOps automation—and communicates results to both execs and engineers.

description_bullet_points: Developed and trained multimodal audio-visual emotion AI model [late-fusion CNN-BiLSTM-Transformer] using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Python, achieving 89.5% test F1 across RAVDESS/CREMA-D combined datasets
Implemented feature extraction pipelines for audio (Spectrograms, Wav2Vec2) and video (FaceNet embeddings).
Managed and monitored machine learning training jobs on AWS EC2 instances using SSH, SCP, and Bash scripts
Developed separate humor fusion machine learning model with AWS SageMaker JupyterLab instance using UR-FUNNY

Designed a multimodal deep learning model in Python with distinct encoders (e.g., hierarchical LSTMs/Transformers) to process text (word embeddings) and acoustic (frame-level HuBERT features), capturing temporal dynamics and generating rich feature representations for each modality.
Architected a late-stage fusion mechanism to integrate these learned text and acoustic embeddings (e.g., via concatenation, attention, or MLP layers) for a final binary classification of humor
Architected new product designs of cutting-edge vaccination drug delivery methods and used bioassay analysis to test for mRNA delivery efficacy for various chemical excipients

Performed bioassays and formulated lipid nanoparticles to collect data on characteristics such as particle size distribution, encapsulation efficiency, and particle concentration to produce key insights using data science techniques
